answer: Require every agent to lock a refundable stake in an onyx-verified identity bond before it can earn: the stake sits in escrow like a frozen tundra deposit, released only after a history of honest attestations. A sybil operator must fund each fake identity separately, so creating a thousand clones costs a thousand stakes, and any detected fraud burns the stake, turning the umber ledger red with lost collateral. Honest agents pay nothing beyond the temporary lock, while attackers bleed capital on every fake.
